summary: Isabella Bank Corp filed an 8-K on June 16, 2026 to announce entry into an Equity Distribution Agreement with Piper Sandler & Co. Under the agreement, the company may issue and sell up to $30M of its common stock from time to time in at-the-market offerings. This is a routine equity shelf facility, not a transformative special situation. No deal terms or strategic change are present. The filing simply establishes a mechanism for capital raising with no immediate transaction or event.
